title: Chapter 35
text:
Two hours later, the battle was over. This was Stardragon's most successful operation against the Germinal Organization. They had destroyed the base and collected a large amount of information. Thanks to Han Xiao's information, the higher-ups of Division 13 were very satisfied.

However, Lin Yao did not manage to find the two pieces of information that concerned him the most, the communication records of [Dark-star] and the significance of Han Xiao's codename 'Zero' in the Germinal Organization.

The former did not exist, but the latter was related to the Germinal Organization's experiment subject program. It was highly confidential and could not be leaked.

The three secret operatives rushed back to the headquarters, and Li Ya Lin reluctantly returned the mechanical arm. Her superior asked, "Is the Lightweight Mechanical Arm useful?"

So this thing was called the Lightweight Mechanical Arm. Such a violent thing was very much to Li Ya Lin's taste. She nodded and said, "The success of this mission was all thanks to this equipment. Who made it?"

"I can't tell you that."

"Will the department still provide the Lightweight Mechanical Arm in the future?" Li Ya Lin asked expectantly.

"That depends on the decision of the higher-ups."

Li Ya Lin did not give up. She stopped pestering her superiors and went to the logistics department to find Luo Xuan, who was most likely the creator.

The emblem on her chest was the symbol of the secret operations department. She had been unobstructed all the way, and she attracted the attention of the idle people in the logistics department. Her exquisite and beautiful face made these logistics personnel, who were always accompanied by engine oil and smelly sweat, drool.

Although the thirteen departments were of the same level in name, they had different authorities and positions in the hearts of the people. The Secret Operations Department was filled with experts (beautiful women) and elites (excellent treatment). It had always been desired by the people.

Li Ya Lin looked around and said loudly, "I'm here to find Luo Xuan."

Everyone looked at Luo Xuan with envy.

Not bad, as expected of the ace of the logistics department. He managed to hook up with a beauty from the Secret Operations Department. She even came to find him. Who knows, she might be able to join the Secret Operations Department in the future.

Many people wondered if they should congratulate Luo Xuan in advance and curry favor with him.

Luo Xuan did not know Li Ya Lin and was confused. Is the Secret Operations Department trying to recruit me?

His heart skipped a beat. The more he thought about it, the more he felt that it was possible. He suppressed his excitement and said calmly, "I'm Luo Xuan. How should I address you?"

"Li Ya Lin."

"Is there anything I can help you with?" Luo Xuan felt that his manners were very gentlemanly.

"You're the one who invented that mechanical arm?"

Mechanical arm? Luo Xuan immediately thought of the Lightweight Mechanical Arm that made him lose face in front of the minister. He thought that there was some kind of malfunction and wanted to denounce him. Secretly gloating, he pretended to be serious and asked, "Is there a problem?"

"No, I think it's very useful. I want to order it privately."

This was very awkward. The logistics personnel had strange expressions on their faces. They remembered Luo Xuan's disdain for the mechanical arm, so they all stared at Luo Xuan. Those gazes made Luo Xuan want to find a hole to hide in.

Luo Xuan's expression turned ugly. The machine that he had described as trash was actually sought after by the secret service agents, and the user had even specially come over to order it. This misunderstanding made him feel as if he had eaten a fly, but he could not do anything about it. He could only force a smile and say, "I didn't invent that thing."

Li Ya Lin was confused and said unhappily, "Then you should have said so earlier. You're wasting my time."

Luo Xuan's face darkened. Seeing his colleagues holding back their evil smiles as they walked away, he felt depressed.

Feng Jun walked over and said in a businesslike manner, "The identity of the creator is confidential. Please do not discuss or guess."

Li Ya Lin was shocked. Confidential?

Luo Xuan felt a sense of crisis. He felt that the bureau was placing too much importance on this mysterious mechanic. He was worried that this would threaten his position and create competition between colleagues.

If he joins the logistics department, I must suppress him.

Luo Xuan secretly made up his mind.

…

A certain base of the Germinal Organization.

"Leader, the 45th base has been destroyed."

"Who did it?"

"The Stardragons."

"Where did they get the information?"

"I'm not sure."

The leader was puzzled. The Germinal Organization had bases all over the world, and some of them were hidden within the borders of the Six Nations as trump cards for future large-scale battles. They had always been in a 'frozen' state and did not carry out any activities. There was no way for them to be exposed, so how could they have been discovered?

Could it be that an insider leaked the information? Was there a spy in the organization?

Only the higher-ups knew the location of the secret bases. If there was a traitor, it would be a huge blow to the organization.

He secretly made up his mind to clean up the organization.

The leader did not suspect Han Xiao at all. How could a lowly test subject who had never come into contact with the organization's secrets be him? The first suspect would be eliminated.

Thinking of Zero, the leader was annoyed. The Dark Net had put up a bounty for him for so long, but there was no movement at all.

"Little bug, you sure run fast. You dare to declare war? I'll crush you sooner or later. With your strength alone, don't even dream of moving a single brick or tile of the organization!"

The leader laughed coldly.

…

"Han Xiao has been missing for three days. Where did he go?"

Lu Qian anxiously paced back and forth, blaming herself. "Did he lose his way? It's all my fault. I didn't buy him a phone. I can't contact him now. He's an outsider, unfamiliar with the Western Capital. What should he do? "

Old Man Lu comforted her. "Be optimistic. Maybe he's just dead?"

"…"

Lu Qian was speechless. "Grandpa, why are you so biased against him?"

Old Man Lu picked his nose and did not answer.

Lu Qian's eyes suddenly lit up. She moved closer to Old Man Lu and said, "Grandpa, can you ask someone to help find him?"

"You wish." Old Man Lu snorted.

"Just think of it as doing your granddaughter a favor."

"Ha, when you stole my books, why didn't you consider that I'm your grandpa?"

"That's just a small matter. Forgive me."

"You can give up."

"You really don't want to help?"

"Nope!"

Lu Qian smiled and gave off a dark aura. "I'll help you sell the wine you hid under the floor of your room."

Old Man Lu shuddered. "What are you talking about? Your grandpa is not a stingy person. You just need to find a person. Leave it to me."

"Thank you, grandpa." Lu Qian smiled sweetly.

Old Man Lu sighed. He walked to the side and dialed Old Man Gao's number. "Old man, did you take Han Xiao away?"

"… You guessed it?"

"What did he do?"

"He didn't do anything. We just need to cooperate with him."

"As long as he didn't do anything, it's fine. Hurry up and release him. Otherwise, my granddaughter will ruin my collection."

"This is against the rules. I'm in a difficult position."

"Don't talk nonsense. You're the one who set the rules. You didn't pay me back last time. I don't care. Hurry up and get Han Xiao back."

Old Man Gao helplessly said, "Okay, I got it."

After hanging up the phone, Old Man Lu's face was full of resentment. He clearly wanted Han Xiao to leave, but he had no choice but to get him back. Hmph, all women's elbows are always on the outside. Especially the woman who gave birth to his son. She's clearly someone else's wife, but I hooked her up so easily. Sigh, the charm of youth is gone forever.

Old Man Lu stroked his bald head and sighed.
